BOTH FRONT PAWS are planted on an invisible horizontal ground plane near y850, staggered slightly, underneath and a little ahead of the shoulders. The dog is NOT standing or walking: its chest sinks low with natural elbows flexing to absorb forward momentum; rump remains higher; BOTH HIND LEGS are folded forward underneath the belly and OFF THE GROUND, white hind paws clearly hovering behind the forelegs. Show a dynamically compressed galloping posture with the spine and pelvis involved, four normally connected limbs, no extra paws, no twisted joints. Head remains looking LEFT with closed mouth, brown eye and the same white muzzle/blaze/ruff, black back, white socks and white tail tip. Full body occupies the central part of the canvas, leave safe margins, nose roughly x180, shoulder roughly x600, hip roughly x1050, tail to x1400. Uniform pale light-gray seamless background, soft even light, no floor texture, no horizon line, no diagram, no text, no collage, no motion blur. The distinctive lower-chest forelimb support silhouette is essential.
